stateFeedbackObservation.observation: All six original PNGs visibly retain disabled selected circular indicators and show 当前选择: on, consistent with native checked=true assertions.
stateFeedbackObservation.source: Demo passes effectiveChecked to Radio checked and uses that same effectiveChecked for output; captured visual-feedback compares output with actual native checked.

scopeLimits: Manual review covers only these 94 original Apple PNGs on Windows Chromium156.0.8078.4, not Firefox/WebKit or Linux pixels.
Every repeated hash was still opened and viewed per case. Matching or differing image hashes do not prove motion or interaction.

Native283 passed, core216/216 and environment including zoom60/60 are automation results of this candidate, separate from manual appearance review. Environment60 includes six zoom cases, not sixty plus six.

Package visual.json declares three sizes, density standard and twelve states. Other standalone density sizes, asynchronous loading and indeterminate are explicitly not applicable: density controls collection spacing, loading belongs to the owning form and Radio has no mixed-value protocol.
Ordinary environment images are medium/standard after actual selection. English, RTL, touch and narrow screenshots do not cover all error/disabled/focus states in those environments.
Native touch tests assert coarse pointer and at least48×48 control region; screenshots show surrounding whitespace but cannot independently establish exact hit geometry.

Real browser zoom is chrome.tabs.setZoom1→2 with CSS viewport width1264→632 and html/body zoom1. DPR increases as a consequence of real zoom, not as a replacement. Images are complete visible viewports, not complete pages.

One no-PNG native boundary case checks disabled-selected forced value from false then restoration, persistence after actual selection, original DOM retention across all six configurations with size/density/English/RTL. No manually viewed PNG is claimed for that interaction sequence.
RadioGroup selection, group keyboard arrows, every placement and all integration boundaries are outside this image set. Single-control defaults and state images do not prove those capabilities.
No video was fully played or inspected second by second. Reduced-motion static PNGs establish visible appearance only.
No original PNG, index, native report, source, build output or baseline was modified. No browser capture or build ran. No canonical approval, pixel baseline approval or verified coverage is granted.
